entity_name: Ministry of Interior and Municipalities (وزارة الداخلية والبلديات)

facts.value: Ministry of Interior and Municipalities. Oversees local governance including municipalities, qadaa-level administration, civil affairs (ID, passports), and the General Directorate of Local Administrations (DGLAC). Escalation authority for inter-municipal disputes and municipal non-compliance. Complaint domains encoded for routing: municipal_non_compliance, inter_municipal_dispute, civil_affairs_complaint, passport_id_issue, local_administration_escalation, municipality_oversight.
